investigations.summary: PBM_FULL Replica set PSMDB 6.0: test_metrics got no metrics because after a PMM logical restore the rs101 mongodb_exporter's MongoDB connection is unauthenticated, and every scrape then panics in makeRegistry (MustRegister of the top collector, exporter.go:239, '(Unauthorized) command top requires authentication') until the exporter restarts; reproduced 3/4 on a CHAOS VM, restarting the exporter cleared it.

ui @instances #12209: PMM-T2010 checked the Aurora PostgreSQL 16 dashboard 40-50 s after adding it, before the QAN agent's first one-minute bucket (agent started 01:09:00.5, first bucket 01:10:00, check 01:09:31-48), so the QAN-backed Execution time panel was empty; it failed 5 of 7 @instances runs on Nov 12-13. Fix polls QAN for the service first; verified in pmm3-ui-tests #12212.
